title: Ampere force expression
description: Essential: The student's answer for part (1) must give the correct sinusoidal function F_A = -(BlU_m/R) sin(2πt/T).

title: Impulse of external force
description: Essential: The student's answer for part (2) must provide the correct impulse expression I_F = (B²l²x₀/R) + (mU_m)/(Bl).

title: Work done by force
description: Essential: The student's answer for part (2) must provide the correct work expression W_F = (U_m²T)/(8R) + (mU_m²)/(2B²l²).

title: Relationship for x₀
description: Essential: The student's answer for part (3) must give the correct relationship x₀ = (T U_m) / (2π B l).

title: Applying motional EMF
description: Important: The solution should correctly relate the maximum voltage U_m to the maximum speed v_m via U_m = Blv_m.

title: Using SHM energy conservation
description: Important: The solution should apply energy conservation in SHM, equating maximum potential energy (½kx₀²) to maximum kinetic energy (½mv_m²).

title: Applying impulse-momentum theorem
description: Important: For part (2), the solution should correctly apply the impulse-momentum theorem, accounting for the impulse of the Ampere force.

title: Calculating Joule heat
description: Important: The solution should correctly calculate the heat dissipated in the resistor over 0-0.25T using Q = (U_m²/(2R)) * (T/4).

title: Sign error in force
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the Ampere force expression in part (1) has an incorrect sign (e.g., missing the negative sign indicating direction).

title: Unit or dimensional inconsistency
description: Pitfall: Penalize if final answers are presented without units or show clear dimensional inconsistency in the derived formulas.
